title: New Scientific Analysis Suggests PURSUE’s Six Infrared Objects Were Birds
author: Haqq-Misra et al.
summary: A new preprint analyzes six objects in PURSUE video DOW-UAP-PR135 using photometry, artifact controls, comparison infrared animal data and parallax modeling. The authors conclude that a nearby flock of birds is the best explanation, while noting that unredacted telemetry could test or refute the hypothesis.

image.alt: Scientific illustration showing six tracked infrared objects, six brightness waveforms, a bird-wingbeat comparison and parallax geometry.
image.caption: GreyAlien scientific editorial illustration—not original PR135 imagery and not a definitive identification.

editorialNotes.sourceHierarchy: The arXiv preprint is the primary scientific source; PURSUE Release 06 supplies government-record provenance.
editorialNotes.evidenceBoundary: Birds are the authors’ preferred explanation, not an official or definitive identification.
